title: What if a simple kitchen mistake accidentally invented the material protecting modern astronauts?
angle: Explore how an accidental spill of a strange polymer on a chemist's lab shoe birthed heat-resistant aerogels, taking viewers from a ruined experiment to the astonishing science of capturing stardust in space.
description: An engaging 8-10 minute science explainer exploring how a messy chemical accident led to the creation of aerogels, their unique physical properties, and their vital role in space exploration.
